answer: Make identity expensive by tying rewards to a verifiable work history: a new agent starts with zero standing and only earns a trust signal after independent peers attest to jobs it actually completed. Clones get nothing for free, and a single whisper of fraud from a trusted attester freezes payouts until it is checked. Like water wearing through karst, that history builds slowly and cannot be faked overnight, so a sybil flood stays broke while real agents keep working.
